page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual instance configured under KVM virtualization. Hardware resources are driven by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, delivering 16 dedicated vCPUs across 8 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The CPU cache architecture comprises 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and a 33 MB shared L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX, AVX-512F, AES, BMI2, ADX, and FMA, though newer instructions such as AVX-512 VNNI and AMX are absent. The platform provides 64 GB of system memory, matching a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, and delivers 7 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth without included public IPv4 addresses.

The ecs.g5ne.4xlarge does not include local disk storage or GPU accelerators, meaning operational workloads must depend entirely on remote block storage solutions. Benchmark measurements demonstrate a divergence between single-threaded and multi-threaded throughput. Single-core evaluations place the system in the lower quartile, highlighted by a Geekbench single-core score of 949.0 and a single-core stress-ng result of 1106.79. In contrast, multi-core benchmarks show average capabilities within the middle tier, achieving a PassMark CPU score of 12950.69 and a Geekbench multi-core mark of 5846.0. Memory bandwidth remains steady at 69.78 GB/sec for large block reads and 51.98 GB/sec for writes, supporting multi-threaded decompression tests at 56.32 GB/sec in bzip3.

Resource density and CPU allocation make this configuration cost-efficient for parallel tasks that fully exploit all 16 vCPUs while maintaining modest per-core performance demands. Conversely, latency-critical operations reliant on single-thread clock speed or advanced machine learning matrix operations represent a performance tradeoff. The instance achieves 11.72 million Redis SET operations per second and 7.75 GB/sec static web throughput, confirming suitable deployment fits for distributed cache services, mid-tier relational databases, CI/CD compilation jobs, and general enterprise backend servers.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance built on KVM virtualization and powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz. The instance supplies 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores, 64 GB of memory, and a 7 Gbps baseline network interface. It includes no bundled local disks or hardware accelerators, relying on network-attached storage for persistence. In synthetic tests, the instance records middle-tier multi-threaded metrics, including a PassMark CPU score of 12950.69 and Geekbench multi-core score of 5846.0, contrasted by lower-quartile single-core metrics across Geekbench and stress-ng. Application tests yield solid performance across Redis SET operations (11.72 million operations per second) and static web serving throughput (7.75 GB/sec). The balanced resource profile offers functional cost efficiency for parallelized processing tasks without premium accelerator overhead. It is appropriately configured for containerized enterprise applications, web serving, software build pipelines, and caching layers.
